text:
Ravi M.: Hello! Starting my first on-call rotation next week. Two quick asks: can someone confirm VPN/runbook access and what's the sign-off criteria to go solo?

Maya R. (oncall-lead): Welcome Ravi :wave: I can confirm access. You'll need SSO or office VPN to reach the runbooks. Sign-off after: (a) two shadowed shifts with a buddy, (b) one tabletop sim completed, and (c) a short oral quiz by the buddy.

Infra Bot: Access update: Ravi M. granted read to /runbooks/oncall at 2024-12-01T09:03Z. PagerDuty invite sent to ravi@example.com.

Ravi M.: Thanks. If my VPN isn't working, who do I ping so I don't block the sign-off?

Lina H.: Ping #help and tag "vpn-access"; also DM me if it times out. I had an issue last month and we reissued a cert. For the sim, use `rw-sim alert create --dry-run` so nothing hits prod.

Maya R. (oncall-lead): Operational note for first shift: ack pages within 2 minutes, open incident channel named incident-<PDID>-<short>, post initial impact and owner. The buddy will verify you ran the triage checklist and can access logs.

Ravi M.: Got it. One more: post-incident writeups — template link?

Maya R. (oncall-lead): Use https://redwood.internal/postmortems/template.md. Required fields: summary, timeline, impact, root cause, mitigation, owners. Keep it short. I'll review the first one.

Ravi M.: Perfect, thanks all. I'll try the dry-run sim tonight and ping if VPN craps out.
